selection: Three selected successful local attempts, plus a creator-measured Product Demo duration. Not a representative sample or success-rate study.
timing: Generation time is the selected successful attempt only, rounded up to whole seconds. Failed attempts, retry waiting, later rebuilds and gaps are excluded. A resumed attempt may reuse saved work, so it is not equivalent to a fresh run. Product Demo remains an creator-reported measured time.
manualMethod: Presentation uses the creator-reported measured manual average of 120 minutes. Sample size and individual timing records are not supplied here. Other manual totals and all stage allocations are planning estimates. The five-minute brief/review allowance is estimated.
limitations: Prepared application, templates and recording workflows were already available. Setup, workflow authoring, earlier development/debugging and later revisions are not included. Retries may reuse completed work. Human intervention was not timed separately. These different tasks are not a controlled quality-matched comparison. No claim of labor hours saved or automatic conversion of one video into three.

runs.label: Product Demo
runs.note: Creator-measured generation time: 5 minutes 16 seconds for a 90-second Product Demo, excluding retries. Reported by the creator; no matching job timestamps are attached. Manual production baseline is about one hour; stage allocations are estimates.

runs.label: Presentation
runs.note: Original app-generated presentation, not the independently edited showcase. First successful run: 8m55s rounded up. Two later successful rebuilds and 13m11s of completed-state gaps are excluded.

runs.label: Spotlight
runs.note: App-generated three-slide feature video with recorded interactions, narration and highlighted captions.

runs.label: Short
runs.note: Successful resumed attempt only: 3m31s rounded up. Reuses saved work from an earlier failed attempt. Excludes 44s of failed processing and 2m26s of retry waiting.
